description: Sum of two unsigned absolute differences; clang emits icmp + 2 sub + select per difference
notes: Original combination of two unsigned absolute differences, inspired by the abs-diff pattern of llvm/llvm-project#234884. A shorter IR form is known and proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 (%4 = call i32 @llvm.umax.i32(i32 %0, i32 %1) %5 = call i32 @llvm.umin.i32(i32 %0, i32 %1) %6 = sub i32 %4, %5 %7 = call i32 @llvm.umax.i32(i32 %1, i32 %2) %8 = call i32 @llvm.umin.i32(i32 %1, i32 %2) %9 = sub i32 %7, %8 %10 = add i32 %6, %9), but it is SLOWER than clang -O3 in llvm-mca on Skylake: 2.85 -> 3.09 cycles (Benoit, reference toolchain, 2026-10-28). No faster version is known, so the entry is C (moved B -> C on 2026-10-28, expected.ll removed).
